title: Levels of particulate matters in air of the Gonabad city, Iran
author: Sajjadi, Atarodi, et al.

steps.title: Prepare sampling materials
steps.instruction: Pre‑wash all plastic equipment with 20 % HCl, rinse thoroughly with deionized water, and store in plastic sacs to avoid contamination before use.

steps.title: Select and install sampling sites
steps.instruction: Choose five suitable locations within the city spaced approximately 1000 m to 4000 m apart, place each petri dish about 3 m above ground level, ensure the weather is dry, and determine the collection area of each dish.

steps.title: Collect dust samples daily
steps.instruction: Using the gravitational dust (petri‑dish) sampling method, collect samples from October to February 2018, retrieving the dishes every 24 h in the same order they were placed.

steps.title: Weigh dishes before and after exposure
steps.instruction: Pre‑weigh each petri dish on a digital scale with an accuracy of 0.0001 g, expose for 24 h, then post‑weigh the same dishes on the same scale.

steps.title: Calculate deposited particle mass
steps.instruction: Subtract the post‑exposure weight from the pre‑exposure weight; divide this difference by the dish surface area and the sampling time to obtain the deposition rate.

steps.title: Perform X‑ray diffraction analysis
steps.instruction: Record the X‑ray diffraction pattern of each collected sample using an X‑ray diffractometer (model XPERT‑PRO) and identify the crystallographic structure of the particulate matter.
